checks.name: faithful
checks.why: Pi 1.4.0 as it is. The shortest path is finding F1: a stop while the child's prompt is in its pre-run window.

checks.name: faithful-other-properties
checks.why: Pi as it is: the properties that no finding breaks hold.

checks.name: f2-dispose-in-prep
checks.why: No pre-run window (a child with synchronous input handlers and a configured login): a stop during _prepareRun and a message that relaunches the child during the abort dispose the session before agent_start (F2).

checks.name: f3-second-stop-refused
checks.why: Pi fixed (no pre-run window, dispose stops a preparing run): a stop of a child that a message relaunched during an earlier stop's abort is refused (F3).

checks.name: f4-old-stop-clears-ending
checks.why: Pi fixed: a stop whose abort waits long ends after a relaunched run and a newer stop began, and its `ending.delete` clears the newer stop's mark (F4).

checks.name: assume-fixes
checks.why: Assume the three fixes: Pi stops a prompt in its pre-run window and a disposed preparing prompt (F1, F2), and a stop of a relaunched child is not refused, with the newest stop owning `ending` (F3). Every property holds.

checks.name: survivor-pump-starts-any
checks.why: Mirrors lib/subagents/slots.ts:89 without the `state !== "queued"` drop. No path in the model leaves a child in line in another state: a stop takes it out of line (team.ts:405), and every other writer that leaves queued (start, go) takes it out first. The guard is for asking and waiting children, which the model leaves out.
